shared_elements: low relief carving with incised interior detail
procession/offering scene with figures facing one another
figures carrying or presenting objects (offering vessel/tray)
register format bounded by horizontal lines
decorative band of repeated motifs / row of small repeated signs
justification: Both are low-relief profile-figure scenes organised in a bounded horizontal register, with human figures facing one direction and one bearing an offering vessel or laden tray, plus a band of repeated small motifs (rosettes in A, sign-row in B). But A is a striding outdoor tribute procession dominated by a large two-humped camel led by attendants, while B is a static seated-figure-before-offering-table composition with a rounded top and a text band, and no animal — the shared traits are the generic conventions of profile relief rather than a common specific scheme.
